name: applied-filters
title: Applied Filters
description: Displays currently active filter selections as dismissible tags grouped by category, with a reset-all button. Designed to pair with FilterDropdown. Uses namespace exports: AppliedFilters.Root, AppliedFilters.CustomGroup, AppliedFilters.Tag.

docs.lead: A horizontal bar that displays currently active filters as dismissible tags, grouped by category. Pairs with FilterDropdown to give users a clear overview of applied filters with one-click removal.

examples.title: Default
examples.description: Multiple filter groups with dismissible tags and a reset button.

examples.title: Custom Group
examples.description: Use CustomGroup and Tag sub-components for custom filter rendering (e.g. search inputs, date ranges).
examples.code:
<AppliedFilters.Root filters={[]} selected={{}} onRemove={() => {}}>
  <AppliedFilters.CustomGroup label="Search" icon={RiSearchLine}>
    <AppliedFilters.Tag onDismiss={() => {}}>query text</AppliedFilters.Tag>
  </AppliedFilters.CustomGroup>
</AppliedFilters.Root>

examples.title: With FilterDropdown
examples.description: Combined with FilterDropdown for a complete filter bar experience.

api.name: AppliedFilters.Root
api.description: The main container that renders all active filter groups with tags and a reset button. Returns null when no filters are active.

props.name: filters
props.description: Filter group definitions. Each group needs a key, label, and options array.

props.name: selected
props.description: Currently selected values per filter key. Same shape as FilterDropdown's selected prop.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Called when a single filter tag is dismissed.

props.name: onRemoveGroup
props.description: Called when all values for a group should be cleared.

props.name: onResetAll
props.description: Called when the reset-all button is clicked. If omitted, the button is hidden.

props.name: label
props.description: Text label shown before the filter groups.

api.name: AppliedFilters.CustomGroup
api.description: A manually composed filter group for non-standard filters (search queries, date ranges, etc.).

api.name: AppliedFilters.Tag
api.description: A pre-styled dismissible tag for use inside CustomGroup.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Called when the tag dismiss button is clicked. If omitted, no dismiss button is shown.
